Given an input sentence, Chinese spelling check (CSC) aims to detect incorrect characters and modify each into a correct character.

Given an input sentence consisting of n characters, denoted as x = x_1 x_2 ... x_n, the goal of a CSC model is to output a corresponding correct sentence, denoted as y = y_1 y_2 ... y_n, in which all erroneous characters in x are replaced with the correct ones.
outputs: corrected sentences with spelling errors fixed
